C.  DISCUSSION ITEM(S)

1.  Recommendation to conduct second reading of Ordinance No. 2023­612, adding Chapter 15.38
  to Title 15 (Buildings and Construction) of the Hawaiian Gardens Municipal Code relating to an
  expedited, streamlined permitting process for electric vehicle charging stations.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  Elise McCaleb, Community Development Director, provided the staff report.

  A motion was made by Councilmember Roa, seconded by Mayor Pro Tem Farfan, to approve
  recommendation and adopt Ordinance No. 2023­612.

  The motion was carried by the following vote:

  AYES: 5; Del Rio, Farfan, Roa, De Paula, Vargas
  NOES: 0;
  ABSENT: 0;
  RECUSE: 0;

  Motion carried: 5–0–0–0

F.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Steve Gomez, Public Safety Director, encouraged the community to drive safely when dropping and
pickup children at school.

Joe Jimenez, Recreation and Community Services Director, thanked the Council for supporting the
back­to­school supply drive and movie night; announced that Recreation is wrapping up summer
programing and introducing fall hours; and that the 23rd annual Pow Wow will be held on August 19­20.

Neema Ghanbari, Public Works Manager announced that the Public Works Block Cleanup Program will
be held August 12th.

Elise McCaleb, Community Development Director announced that a job fair will be held at C.
Robert Lee on August 17th.

G.  CITY ATTORNEY REPORT(S)

There were no City Attorney Reports.

H.  ORAL COUNCIL REPORT(S)

Mayor Del Rio announced that she attended National Night Out; attended the movie night; attended Top
Soccer; and reported that she attended the Independent Cities Association Seminar.

Councilmember De Paula announced that he attended the Top Soccer event.

Councilmember Roa announced that he attended National Night Out; and reported that he attended the
Independent Cities Association Seminar;

Mayor Pro Tem Farfan reported that he attended the Independent Cities Association Seminar; National
Night Out; Grand Opening at the new pickleball courts at Don Knabe; and the rugby tournament.

Councilmember Vargas announced that he attended National Night Out, and the youth program ruby
tournament.

I.  CLOSED SESSION

There were no Closed Session items.

J.  ADJOURNMENT

The City Council adjourned the meeting at 7:19 PM to the next City Council meeting to be held
on Tuesday, August 22, 2023, at 6:00 PM
